reason: Not paying upfront is nice, but I want someone to take the whole thing off my plate for years, and a one-man freelancer in Kuwait with no UK clients isn't who I'd trust to still be there when something breaks. I'd also be signing up for £43 a month forever, plus they'd nudge me towards £325 SEO.
objection: Ongoing monthly costs that never stop, paid to someone I can't pop round to see, who might disappear and leave me stuck with a site I don't know how to manage.
would_change_my_mind: A couple of real Manchester businesses I can ring who say he's sorted everything for them, plus a clear promise in writing of what the £43 covers and that I can leave with my site anytime.
